primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.effort_target: 75-85% promotion/verification until backlog is materially reduced; 15-25% breadth expansion
verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict

development_recovery.primary_bottleneck: Bibliographic identities are not inspected content; maintenance had no acquisition step and no content inspection.
development_recovery.required_agent_action: Continue item-level source review, prioritizing original-language Hebrew/Yiddish/English witnesses and additional document types; keep translations linked to their underlying Evidence Family and preserve partial-context limits.
development_recovery.last_run_note: Batch 070 reviewed twelve Hebrew Library item identities through official search-visible body excerpts: ten new letters and two in-place enrichments of existing batch-068 identities. Added twenty new propositions plus two propositions to existing identities, all non-verbatim and scoped to the visible excerpt; direct page opens returned zero readable lines, incoming letters and manuscripts were not inspected, and context remains partial. Seven Chabad.org AID candidates redirected to rewritten summary shells and were excluded; official Chabad Library search excerpts were used as the alternative. Dedup checked the queue, batches 057/060/065–069, bulk indexes 001–004 and response-cases-002; a full scan of all canonical files was not available. No crawler retry, access bypass or full-text copying. Metrics before reconciliation: 719 answer-eligible families, 716 content-verified families and 2448 propositions; expected after: 729, 726 and 2470.
